title: Enhance the broader Day Setup visual hierarchy
objective: Apply a bounded visual enhancement to Day Setup so scan order, grouping, and action hierarchy are clear without adding workflow steps or state transitions: each section renders as a distinct card in a fixed top-to-bottom order, the Frame group contains every day-frame field (preset, allotment, anchor, EOD, buffering), and the terminal Cancel/Save bar is separated from the last section by its own divider while keeping secondary/primary hierarchy.

treatment.section_grouping: SetupDrawer wraps each h3 group in <section class="setup-section" aria-labelledby="setup-sec-*"> with a .setup-section__head (stronger h3: text color, weight 600) and a .setup-section__body. Sections scan top-to-bottom: Frame, [Mint sessions when present], Anchored blocks, Live micro-adventure, Captures.
treatment.frame_group: Start (anchor), End of day, and Buffering fields moved into the Frame section body so every day-frame field groups under one card. Mint sessions (conditional) renders as its own card between Frame and Anchored blocks. Behavior, labels, ids, and handlers unchanged — DOM order only.
treatment.action_bar: Terminal actions div gains class setup__actions on top of the shared editor__actions: own top border, padding, and larger top margin visually separate Cancel (secondary .btn) and Save day setup (primary .btn--primary). BlockEditor and AnchoredEditor keep the untouched editor__actions baseline.
treatment.responsive: @media (max-width: 520px): cards trim padding, .anchored-row__controls wraps instead of spilling past the viewport, and the action bar wraps with full-width buttons. No horizontal overflow at desktop or narrow widths.

measurable.section_order: sectionHeadings === ['Frame', 'Anchored blocks', 'Live micro-adventure', 'Captures'] on the base scenario; every .setup-section carries a .setup-section__head h3 and a .setup-section__body
measurable.frame_membership: Day preset, Work allotment, Start (anchor), End of day, Buffering all have closest('.setup-section') equal to the Frame section
measurable.mint_position: with mintSessions loaded, 'Mint sessions' heading sits between 'Frame' and 'Anchored blocks'
measurable.action_hierarchy: .setup__actions present; Save is .btn--primary; Cancel is .btn without btn--primary; Reset to config is .btn inside the Frame section; Cancel closes without persisting; Save persists and closes
